For years, I thought “networking” meant collecting business cards and having awkward small talk at industry events. Honestly, it felt… draining. I’d go home feeling like I’d *performed* networking, not actually *connected* with anyone. I remembered her mentioning struggling with Python, so I offered to spend an hour each week walking her through some fundamentals. No agenda, no expectation of anything in return. Just helpfulness.
